mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_conversation_session (user_id, session_name, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sessionName}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, session_name, create_time, update_time FROM ai_conversation_session WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, user_id, session_name, create_time, update_time FROM ai_conversation_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_conversation_session SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
